title: E2E.Test.RAR5.Solid.Encrypted.MissingMiddle.PAR2.2026.1080p-TESTGRP
description: Solid, data-encrypted RAR5 split across four volumes with the interior third volume omitted. PAR2 carries 382 recovery blocks (about a third of the set) and must repair before extraction. Three verification passes are the intended shape: one against the live stream, one at exhaustion to name the missing blocks a promotion must target, and one after the promoted recovery lands to hand the analyzer to repair.
